_doc: Real interview clips for the cold open. Source files live in clips/src/ (not committed). 'in'/'out' are seconds in the source file. 'quote' is the exact words spoken (verified with a Whisper transcript, word timestamps): it drives the captions. 'credit' is shown on screen. Run `python3 prep_clips.py`, then `python3 build_audio.py`. Optional 'video_hold_after' (seconds into the clip) freezes the picture on the last on-camera frame when the source cuts away.

clips.speaker: Dr. Russell Blaylock
clips.quote: They put so much MSG in food because it makes you hungry and you eat more of their food.
clips._note: The source fades to black and cuts to a lecture slide 1.3 s in; the video holds his last on-camera frame while his audio continues.
